definitions.gloss: plastic model kit; scale model made of plastic
definitions.explanation: A kit for building a scale model made primarily of plastic parts, requiring assembly and often painting.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}はよくプラモデルを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I used to build a lot of plastic models when I was a kid.

examples.japanese: ガンダムのプラモデルを{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: I collect Gundam plastic model kits.

examples.japanese: プラモデルを{組|く}み{立|た}てるのが{趣味|しゅみ}だ。
examples.english: Building plastic models is my hobby.

examples.japanese: このプラモデルは{細|こま}かいパーツが{多|おお}くて{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: This plastic model has many small parts and is difficult.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of プラスチックモデル (plastic model). The term is wasei-eigo (Japanese-made English).

ABBREVIATION:
Often shortened to プラモ in casual speech.

POPULAR TYPES:
- ガンプラ: Gundam plastic models (very popular in Japan)
- {戦車|せんしゃ}モデル: tank models
- {飛行機|ひこうき}モデル: airplane models
- {車|くるま}モデル: car models
- {艦船|かんせん}モデル: ship models

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プラモデルを{作|つく}る: build a plastic model
- プラモデルを{組|く}み{立|た}てる: assemble a plastic model
- プラモデルを{塗装|とそう}する: paint a plastic model

CULTURAL NOTE:
Plastic model building is a popular hobby in Japan, with major manufacturers like Bandai and Tamiya. Gunpla (Gundam plastic models) is particularly associated with Japanese hobbyist culture.
